swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: OPA2333AIDR is limited to 5.5 V max (7 V abs max, p.5) whereas LM358DR supports up to 30 V (32 V abs max, p.4). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LM358DR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR vs OPA2333AIDR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 700x (LM358DR: 7 mV p.10 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.01 mV p.7); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 286x (LM358DR: 20000 pA p.10 vs OPA2333AIDR: 70 pA p.7); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 20.6x (LM358DR: 350 µA/ch p.10 vs OPA2333AIDR: 17 µA/ch p.7); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: OPA2333AIDR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (7 V, p.5) than LM358DR (32 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 7 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM358DR requires Vs,min >= 3 V (p.5) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM358DR: 0..70 °C Commercial (0°C to 70°C) vs OPA2333AIDR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 125°C)); LM358DR cold limit only 0 °C, LM358DR hot limit only 70 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM358DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and OPA2333AIDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; input offset voltage Vos differs 700x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 0.7 MHz (p.10) vs 0.35 MHz (p.7), supply ceiling 30 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.5), Vos 7 mV (p.10) vs 0.01 mV (p.7), Ib 286x gap (20000 vs 70 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM358DR "Non-Rail-to-Rail Upper Input and Output Headroom Ceiling" (p.10) and OPA2333AIDR "Weak ±5 mA Output Drive and 350 kHz / 0.16 V/µs Speed vs Pin-Identical TLV9002/TLV9062/LMV358" (p.7). BOM decision: Choose LM358DR when supply rails exceed 5.5 V (rated up to 30 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 0.7 MHz GBWP; choose OPA2333AIDR when DC precision demands <= 0.01 mV max Vos or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (70 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
